steps.title: Repeat
steps.text: This block runs the blocks inside it again and again, a number of times. It saves you from dragging the same blocks over and over.

steps.title: Forever
steps.text: This one never stops. It's perfect for games where something keeps happening.

steps.title: Try it yourself!
steps.text: I've added a “when green flag clicked” block to your code area. Drag “repeat 10” under it, then put a “move” or “turn” block inside, and click the green flag.

waitFor.label: Drag the “repeat” block under the hat block

steps.title: Wait
steps.text: This block pauses the script for a number of seconds. Use it between two blocks so you have time to see each one.

steps.title: Try it yourself!
steps.text: I've added a “when green flag clicked” block and a “say Hello!” block to your code area. Drag “wait 1 seconds” under the “say” block, and add another “say” under that. Then click the green flag.

waitFor.label: Drag the “wait” block under the “say” block

tours.title: Make a choice
tours.description: Do something only if it is true.

steps.title: If
steps.text: This block runs the blocks inside it only if the condition is true. Put a hexagon block, like “touching mouse-pointer?”, in its slot. “if / else” does something else when it isn't true.

steps.title: Try it yourself!
steps.text: I've added a “when green flag clicked” block to your code area. Drag “if” under it. Then put “touching mouse-pointer?” (from Sensing) in the condition and a “say” inside, and click the green flag while pointing at your sprite.

waitFor.label: Drag the “if” block under the hat block
